purpose: Software validation using invented records; no clinical conclusions
population: All records in this fixture represent eligible synthetic adults
unit_of_analysis: One record per unique synthetic participant
exposure: A or B are synthetic groups with no treatment meaning
outcome: Invented binary event during the same fixed follow-up window; blank means unobserved
missingness: Available per variable; no imputation; missing outcomes not classified as non-events
timing: lab_day must be <= index_day for the baseline laboratory field
analysis: Descriptive summaries only; no exclusions or adjustment
bounds: Scenario engineering specifications, not clinical reference ranges
limitations: Completeness of follow-up, causal effects and real-world validity cannot be inferred
